title: Bento UI motion grid: a locked-off grid of 24 polished UI cards on a light background where every card animates continuously and independently with spring easing, rolling digits and crossfades, staggered spring intro, rendered at 120 fps with a 60 fps cut for X
creator: @dominikmartn (format reference); original widgets and code by James Camarota
techniques: single index.html with a pure draw(t) that re-renders every card for time t
from-rest damped spring, critically damped soft ease, ease-out-expo for reveals, quintic in-out for long travel
per-digit odometer rolling with tabular figures and stagger
independent per-card cycles with staggered offsets plus ambient sine motion
FLIP-style stack and list pushes (chat, notifications, kanban, avatars)
staggered spring intro keyed by card x/y
Playwright capture at 2.8125x then Lanczos downscale to 1440x1080
parallel frame workers, 120 fps master and 60 fps cut from the same frames
per-card frame-diff spike detector for smoothness QA
use_cases: "this model can actually design" social flex post
design system or component library showcase
app concept teaser with many features at once
portfolio reel for a UI or front end designer
pick_when: you need a silent 24 s locked-off grid of many polished UI widgets that all animate smoothly at once, ultra smooth (120 fps master), easy to re-skin in one HTML file.
avoid_when: you need camera moves through one flow (pastel-glow-ui-film), a cursor-led tool tour (figma-motion-launch), a changelog film (linear-releases) or a hard-cut collage (fast-collage-recolor-demo).
fidelity_notes: Format match only (locked-off 4:3 bento grid, 24 s, continuous per-card motion, staggered intro). All widgets, copy, palette and code are original; no assets from the reference.
